kavieng.owner: HongBlack / contextsforreading.com (blog; copyright, permission not confirmed)
kavieng.what_it_shows: Low aerial of Kavieng town centre (shops, roads) with the harbour behind, taken from a plane window. Cropped to remove the window frame and the 'HongBlack' watermark at the left edge; a faint window reflection remains.

lihir-group.what_it_shows: Low-altitude aerial of a small forested Lihir-group islet with the main Lihir island and its mountains on the horizon; clear sky, no people or text.
tried: australianminingreview Lihir mine aerial (1200 px, shows the plant, not the island; alternative at https://australianminingreview.com.au/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/Newmonts-Lihir-One-of-Papua-New-Guineas-largest-gold-mines.jpg)

lorengau.note: Best lead is an aerial of Lorengau waterfront at https://www.businessadvantagepng.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/03/Manus_RockyRoe.jpg (photographer Rocky Roe) but only 580x302 px; no larger copy found. Seabourn, Harbourside Hotel, Seeadler Bay Hotel and TripAdvisor images are hotel or interior shots.

buka.note: Nothing usable at 960 px that shows Buka town. ramblinrandy.com blog has a 1000 px colourful shot of Buka waterfront with a boat in the foreground (https://www.ramblinrandy.com/oceania/bougainville-buka-papua-new-guinea/, file papua-new-guinea-bougainville-travel-00021 area), but the boat is the subject. christoph.today photos are lower quality.
tried: discoverbougainville.org about-bougainville, getting-here, things-to-do, adventure-walks, transport

mount-balbi.owner: Rotokas Eco-Tourism (Mount Balbi trek operator, Bougainville)
mount-balbi.what_it_shows: Turquoise crater lake and fumarole-streaked crater wall at the summit of Mount Balbi, seen over flax-like grass; no people or text.
mount-balbi.alternative: https://rotokasecotourism.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/04/img_6041.jpg (5184x3456): Mount Balbi's cloud-topped cone seen from a village, two people sitting small in the foreground.

alotau-1.owner: Travel Obscure (blog; drone photo, copyright, permission not confirmed)
alotau-1.what_it_shows: Top-down drone view of Samarai Island's wharf and jetty on the reef with the island's houses and trees; no people or text.
tried: adventure-life.com (stock photo of Raja Ampat, rejected)
ponant.com Samarai photos (hillside, not clearly Samarai)

alotau-3.note: Normanby Island: only ljaxphotos.com photos (Spirit of Niugini, 2008, framed with caption border and copyright signature) and a trek-papua.com panorama of an unidentified islet. Neither passes.
tried: jennifermarohasy.com (that Normanby is in Queensland, rejected)

alotau-5.owner: PONANT (cruise operator; copyright, permission not confirmed)
alotau-5.what_it_shows: Steaming Deidei geothermal pool and mud flats on Fergusson Island with forest and hills behind; no people or text. Shows a site on the island, not the island as a whole.

misima-island.note: Best found: https://www.cruisingtheedge.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/misima-1.jpg (1442x741), a blog photo of Bwagaoia harbour dominated by a yacht; rejected as the subject is the boat. Other results are sport-fishing beach shots (rockexpeditions.com, watermarked) and a portrait (papuanewguinea.travel).

goodenough-island.owner: Unknown Google Maps contributor via sandee.com (copyright, owner not identified)
goodenough-island.what_it_shows: Row of tall coconut palms along the Bolubolu shore of Goodenough Island with the wharf and a boat, and the island's mountain range under cloud behind. Cropped to remove the boat bow in the foreground.

madang-3.note: Krangket Island: no photo of the island itself found. Aerials by Madang Resort Hotel (squarespace DJI_0900-2, DJI_0253-Pano) and Messersmith plane shots show unnamed Madang islands/town, not confirmed as Krangket. realjourneytravels.com/wp-content/uploads/Krangket-Island-Lodge-Madang.jpg and the papuanewguinea.travel kayaking-near-Kranget story photo were small or a person/unverified.
